from pathlib import Path
program_dir=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792485222/attempts/83275b2e45034ad1868f4c57ede5090a/system/state/workspace/programs')
program_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
p=program_dir/'task-6792c931.py'
source='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep = next(c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == grid[0][c] != 0 for r in range(h)))
    # The separators are regularly spaced; infer the panel dimensions from them.
    row_seps = [r for r in range(h) if all(v == grid[r][0] != 0 for v in grid[r])]
    col_seps = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == grid[0][c] != 0 for r in range(h))]
    rh = row_seps[0]
    cw = col_seps[0]
    rows = [(a + 1, b) for a, b in zip([-1] + row_seps, row_seps + [h])]
    cols = [(a + 1, b) for a, b in zip([-1] + col_seps, col_seps + [w])]
    rows = [(a, b) for a, b in rows if a < b]
    cols = [(a, b) for a, b in cols if a < b]
    # A marked panel in the first column supplies one color per panel row.
    colors = []
    for r0, r1 in rows:
        vals = [grid[r][c] for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(cols[0][0], cols[0][1]) if grid[r][c] != 0]
        colors.append(vals[0])
    # The nonempty panel outside the marker column contains the shape to copy.
    motif = None
    for i, (r0, r1) in enumerate(rows):
        for j, (c0, c1) in enumerate(cols[1:], start=1):
            pts = [(r-r0, c-c0) for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1) if grid[r][c] != 0]
            if pts:
                motif = pts
                break
        if motif is not None:
            break
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for i, (r0, r1) in enumerate(rows):
        for c0, c1 in cols:
            for dr, dc in motif:
                out[r0+dr][c0+dc] = colors[i]
    return out
'''
p.write_text(source)
print(p)
